question: Should bundled dashboard log-tail and command-output widgets be added now, and what exact gateway log-stream, command-output, redaction, permission, retention, and export contract must they follow?
rationale: The feature is aligned with operator ergonomics, but it exposes logs and command output in a new always-visible dashboard surface and currently lacks the backend stream/output contract the contributor identified as prerequisite work.

options.title: Stage After Stream Contract
options.body: Keep this issue open until the dashboard substrate and backend stream/output API are approved, then implement the widgets against that reviewed contract.

options.title: Narrow To Existing Read-Only Sources
options.body: Permit a smaller widget that only consumes existing bounded read surfaces such as `logs.tail` and `terminal.text`, excluding command execution and generic stream bindings.

options.title: Defer Bundled Builtins
options.body: Leave this as roadmap context until maintainers decide whether log/output dashboard widgets belong in bundled OpenClaw or external plugin work.

recommendation.title: Stage After Stream Contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the dashboard substrate and backend stream/output API are approved, then implement the widgets against that reviewed contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main ownership signal is the Control UI plugin-tab and Logbook precedent that this dashboard design reuses.
